title: Electric part of the system is a joke
text: Electric part of the system is a joke. USPRO Electric Wine Bottle Opener, Automatic Corkscrew Gift Sets Powered Cork Remover Kit Includes Pourer, I use the round cutting system to cut the top of the bottle it works fine as you can see in the photo, but when I try to use the electronic part of the wine opener it did not work for me. I tried to use regular batteries it would not work at all. I used rechargeable battery it still did not work. I put in alkaline batteries it worked a little bit. I tried to remove the cork and it only came up about an inch. I had to use my old fashion Corkscrew puller to get the cork out of the bottle. The wind spout works well, and the pump works well. The electrical part did not do a good job for me. I tried to read the instructions twice but no dice. It might work for you, but for me I am through.  OZ
